items.name: imageclassic
items.tagline: Four classic image models on one chute: FLUX.1-schnell + three SDXL checkpoints
items.readme:
## Four classic image models, one chute

**imageclassic** bundles four standalone text-to-image models into a single deployment. All pipelines load at startup — pick a model per request without switching chutes or redeploying.

### Models

**FLUX.1-schnell** (`model: flux` · `POST /image/flux`)
12B rectified-flow transformer distilled for 1–4 step generation. Best for fast, high-quality images from simple prompts; strong prompt following, no negative prompt needed. Defaults: 4 steps, guidance 3.5.

**Dreamshaper XL 1.0** (`model: dreamshaper` · `POST /image/dreamshaper`)
Versatile SDXL fine-tune for general-purpose generation — portraits, fantasy, sci-fi, stylized scenes. Supports negative prompts. Defaults: 25 steps, guidance 7.5.

**iLustMix v80** (`model: ilustmix` · `POST /image/ilustmix`)
SDXL illustration/anime checkpoint by GZees — semi-realistic characters, detailed anatomy, cinematic and anime-style art. Supports negative prompts. Defaults: 25 steps, guidance 7.5.

**Juggernaut XL Ragnarok** (`model: juggernaut` · `POST /image/juggernaut`)
RunDiffusion photorealistic SDXL checkpoint — photography-style realism, digital painting, improved poses and anatomy. Supports negative prompts. Defaults: 25 steps, guidance 7.5.

### API

- `POST /generate` — unified entry; set `model` to `flux`, `dreamshaper`, `ilustmix`, or `juggernaut` (drop-in for legacy `/generate` clients)
- `POST /image/flux`, `/image/dreamshaper`, `/image/ilustmix`, `/image/juggernaut` — model-specific endpoints

All endpoints return **image/jpeg** (quality 85).

items.name: AudioDojo
items.tagline: One chute, 12 models, 13 endpoints — covering text-to-speech, voice cloning, voice design, transcription, denoising, source separation, speaker verification, VAD, and language detection. Including Kokoro-82M, Qwen3-TTS 1.7B, Whisper large-v3-turbo, NVIDIA Canary-Qwen 2.5B, and NVIDIA Parakeet TDT.
items.readme:
# AudioDojo

A full-featured audio AI toolkit running 12 models behind 13 REST endpoints — all on a single chute. Send a request to any endpoint and get results back instantly; every model is loaded in GPU memory at all times, so there are no cold-start delays between calls.

---

## Text-to-Speech (TTS)

| Endpoint | Model | What it does |
|----------|-------|--------------|
| `/speak` | Kokoro-82M | **Legacy alias** — same request/response contract as the original `chutes/kokoro` chute (`text`, `voice`, `speed` → `audio/wav`). Use this path if you are migrating from the standalone Kokoro deployment without changing client code. |
| `/tts/kokoro` | Kokoro-82M | Same Kokoro synthesis as `/speak`; preferred path for new integrations. Ultra-fast TTS with **54 built-in voices** across 9 languages. Sub-second latency. |
| `/tts/qwen3clone` | Qwen3-TTS 1.7B | **Zero-shot voice cloning** — provide 3–6 seconds of any voice as a reference clip and the model speaks new text in that voice. |
| `/tts/qwen3custom` | Qwen3-TTS 1.7B | **Preset speakers + emotion control** — choose from 9 speaker identities and steer delivery with free-text instructions like "excited", "whispering", "calm and slow". |
| `/tts/qwen3design` | Qwen3-TTS 1.7B | **Voice design from text** — describe the voice you want in plain English (e.g. "a warm confident male narrator with a slight British accent") and the model creates it on the fly. No reference audio needed. |

## Speech-to-Text (STT)

| Endpoint | Model | What it does |
|----------|-------|--------------|
| `/stt/whisper` | Whisper large-v3-turbo | Fast multilingual transcription — **99 languages**, optional word-level timestamps. |
| `/stt/canary` | NVIDIA Canary-Qwen 2.5B | High-accuracy English ASR via speech-augmented language model. Best for complex or domain-specific audio. |
| `/stt/parakeet` | NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 | Real-time English transcription with word and segment timestamps in a single pass. |

## Audio Processing

| Endpoint | Model | What it does |
|----------|-------|--------------|
| `/audio/vad` | Silero VAD | **Voice activity detection** — returns precise start/end timestamps of speech segments. |
| `/audio/denoise` | MetricGAN+ | **Speech enhancement** — removes background noise from recordings. Returns cleaned audio. |
| `/audio/separate` | SepFormer | **Source separation** — isolates speech from music/noise. Returns the separated vocal track. |
| `/audio/verifyspeaker` | ECAPA-TDNN | **Speaker verification** — compares two audio clips and returns a similarity score + same-speaker decision. |
| `/audio/detectlanguage` | Whisper | **Language detection** — identifies the spoken language and returns a confidence score. |
| `/audio/diarize` | — | Speaker diarization (identifies who spoke when). |

---

## Legacy Kokoro (`POST /speak`)

Drop-in replacement for clients that called the old **kokoro** chute:

- **Method/path:** `POST /speak`
- **Body:** `{"text": "...", "voice": "af_heart", "speed": 1.0}` — `voice` and `speed` are optional (defaults: `af_heart`, `1.0`)
- **Response:** `audio/wav` (24 kHz), same as before
- **Implementation:** identical Kokoro-82M pipeline as `POST /tts/kokoro`; only the URL differs

```bash
# Legacy kokoro clients — no code changes except the chute base URL
curl -X POST https://YOUR_CHUTE_BASE/speak \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "Hello world!", "voice": "af_heart", "speed": 1.0}' \
  -o output.wav
```

## Quick Start

TTS endpoints accept JSON (`text`, optional `voice`/`speed`) and return `audio/wav`. STT and utility endpoints use base64-encoded audio and return JSON.

```bash
# Text-to-Speech via /tts/kokoro (returns audio/wav)
curl -X POST https://YOUR_CHUTE_BASE/tts/kokoro \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"text": "Hello world!", "voice": "af_heart", "speed": 1.0}' \
  -o output.wav

# Speech-to-Text (returns JSON)
curl -X POST https://ttsstt-audio-megachute/stt/whisper \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"audio_b64": "<base64-encoded-audio>", "return_timestamps": true}'
```

## Available Kokoro Voices

54 voices with naming convention `<language><gender>_<name>`:

- **American English** — af_heart, af_bella, af_jessica, af_nicole, af_nova, af_river, af_sarah, af_sky, am_adam, am_echo, am_eric, am_liam, am_michael, am_onyx, am_puck, am_santa, and more
- **British English** — bf_alice, bf_emma, bf_isabella, bf_lily, bm_daniel, bm_fable, bm_george, bm_lewis
- **Spanish** — ef_dora, em_alex, em_santa
- **French** — ff_siwis
- **Hindi** — hf_alpha, hf_beta, hm_omega, hm_psi
- **Italian** — if_sara, im_nicola
- **Japanese** — jf_alpha, jf_gongitsune, jf_nezumi, jf_tebukuro, jm_kumo
- **Portuguese** — pf_dora, pm_alex, pm_santa
- **Chinese** — zf_xiaobei, zf_xiaoni, zf_xiaoxiao, zf_xiaoyi, zm_yunjian, zm_yunxi, zm_yunyang

## Qwen3 Custom Speakers

Vivian, Serena, Uncle_Fu, Dylan, Eric, Ryan, Aiden, Ono_Anna, Sohee

items.name: meta/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4-TEE
items.tagline: Agentic multimodal: images + text in, reasoning and tool calls out
items.readme:
## Muse Glimmer 30B — NVFP4 multimodal agent on Chutes

OpenAI-compatible **/v1/chat/completions** hosting [Muse Glimmer 30B](https://huggingface.co/meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B) (NVFP4) via SGLang on a single **RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell**, TEE-enabled.

### What it does

Muse Glimmer is a 29.6B dense multimodal model from Meta Superintelligence Labs, distilled from Muse Spark and purpose-built for autonomous agentic work: multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use, image understanding, and failure recovery in one model. Apache 2.0.

### Modalities

| Direction | Supported |
|-----------|-----------|
| **In** | Text, image (`image_url`) |
| **Out** | Text, with separate `reasoning_content` and tool calls |

### Quantization

NVFP4 W4A4 across 416 decoder projections. The **full ViT-G/14 perception encoder, vision adapters, embeddings and LM head remain BF16** — this is a true multimodal deployment, not a text-only quant.

### Runtime

- **Context:** 131,072 tokens
- **Speculative decoding:** DFlash block-diffusion drafter
- **GPU:** 1x RTX PRO 6000 (SM120), >=80 GB VRAM, TEE

### Sampling

Meta's published defaults: `temperature=1.0`, `top_p=0.95`, `top_k=64`. Do not use greedy decoding. Set reasoning depth with a system prompt line such as `Reasoning strength: high` (`low` | `medium` | `high` | `xhigh`).
